# aether_webhook (Resource)

An outbound webhook of the provider's organization: the platform POSTs signed event payloads to `url`. An organization can hold at most 10 webhooks, disabled ones included; the 11th is refused by the API. The signing `secret` is returned by the API only when the webhook is created and when it is rotated; it is never readable afterwards. Change `rotate_secret` to rotate it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "webhook_secret_rotation" {
  type    = string
  default = "2026-09"
}

# The signing secret is returned only on create and on rotation; change
# rotate_secret to rotate it. At most 10 webhooks per organization.
resource "aether_webhook" "alerts" {
  url           = "https://hooks.example.com/aether"
  description   = "Cluster lifecycle and budget alerts"
  events        = ["cluster.ready", "cluster.degraded", "usage.alert"]
  rotate_secret = var.webhook_secret_rotation
}

output "webhook_secret" {
  value     = aether_webhook.alerts.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `events` (Set of String) Event types to deliver, or exactly `["*"]` for all of them. Known types (as of this provider's API version): `cluster.created`, `cluster.ready`, `cluster.upgraded`, `cluster.degraded`, `cluster.deleted`, `node.replaced`, `usage.alert`, `invoice.generated`, `ticket.updated`. An unknown type is refused by the API at apply.
- `url` (String) Delivery endpoint. Must be an absolute `https` URL with a host and without embedded credentials. The API also refuses literal IP addresses in private or internal ranges and, unless the platform allows it, `http`; those are checked at apply, not at plan.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description. Defaults to `""`; removing it clears the stored description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether events are delivered. Defaults to `true`. The API can only create a webhook enabled, so `enabled = false` at creation is a create followed by a disable call: the endpoint may receive events between creation and the disable call (aether-api#306). If the disable call fails, the webhook is recorded enabled and marked tainted, and the next apply replaces it.
- `rotate_secret` (String) Change this value to rotate the signing secret; the value itself is never sent to the API. After an import, set it once to obtain a secret. Setting it on a new webhook rotates nothing (creation already issues a fresh secret), and removing it rotates nothing.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Webhook UUID.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Signing secret (`whsec_` + 48 hex characters). The API returns it only on creation and on rotation, so it is null after an import until `rotate_secret` is set.
- `updated_at` (String) Time the webhook was last written (RFC 3339).
